verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Justworks collects W-4 equivalent info (filing status/withholding) during employee enrollment, and general onboarding timeline exists, but there's no direct evidence of an I-9 collection step or bank/direct-deposit detail collection within a self-serve pre-day-one flow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of I-9 verification collection, bank account/direct deposit setup during onboarding, and confirmation that the full flow is completed before day one.
